scope: structural impulse-response validation for FlyDSL conv3d

upstream_context.title: [Feature]: conv3d_implicit — accept and emit NDHWC so chained convs skip the layout round-trip
upstream_context.conclusion: Current mirror main already implements independent input_layout and output_layout support; this change adds a distinct structural oracle rather than duplicating a fix.

oracle.kind: small impulse response with distinctive asymmetric weights
oracle.reference: independent Torch CPU float32 cross-correlation via torch.nn.functional.conv3d, cast to bfloat16
